items.html: Now we shall explain the matter of the hairs of the head of Zeir Anpin. Know that in the head of Zeir Anpin there are three kinds of hair, and they are called: barbs (Kutzin), locks (Nimin), and hairs (Se'arot). And the explanation of the matter is that we have already explained that Zeir Anpin has three aspects, namely: the first Ibur, the suckling (Yenika), and the second Ibur of Gadlut. And the Mochin of the first Ibur and of the suckling are Names of Elohim, and the Mochin of Gadlut are Names of YHVH.
